studio.faqstockAnswer: Confirmed sales reduce stock. Received purchases and saved stock movements update it. A purchase order alone does not add stock.
studio.faqpaymentQuestion: Does recording UPI verify the transfer?
studio.faqpaymentAnswer: No. Record a payment after checking that you received it. DukaanSet keeps your entry; it does not verify bank or UPI transfers.
studio.faqclosingQuestion: Will opening the closing page close my shop?
studio.faqclosingAnswer: No. Review the transactions, count cash and acknowledge the summary. The shop closes only when you select Confirm closing.
